delta_basis: Initial pinned decision after user refined access to invited Google accounts.

verdict.rationale: Direct IAP supports allowlisted Google principals and coverage of run.app ingress. Suitability remains conditional on OAuth configuration, deployed access controls, verified identity handling and Gradio compatibility. With unresolved P1 checks and no comparative evidence, winner not established.
verdict.separating_test: Run the same app through direct IAP and load-balancer IAP with one allowlisted and one non-allowlisted Google account. Test signed-out access, Gradio queue/stream requests, run.app bypass and forged identity headers; record setup changes and results.
